subject: GREEN: runtime/linux/loader.{h,c} -- ELF read + PT_LOAD mapping
description: Implement load_elf(): open the app via g_manifest.app_path (newlib open/read/lseek, already wired), validate ELF64/RISCV magic, read phdrs, map each PT_LOAD (reject overlap with vlinux's own region via _vlinux_base/_stack), zero the BSS tail, compute AT_PHDR by locating the PT_LOAD segment covering e_phoff. Output: entry, phdr vaddr, phnum, phentsize.
